title: Language Model Integration
summary: This module orchestrates all interactions with Language Models (LMs) within DSPy, providing client integrations for various LMs, caching for performance, API-specific data formatting, and essential utilities for logging and secure data handling.

nodes.label: LM Client Integrations
nodes.title: Language Model Clients
nodes.description: Manages connections and interactions with various Language Models, including LiteLLM-based clients and finetuning integrations.

nodes.label: LM Caching & Embeddings
nodes.title: Caching & Embedding Services
nodes.description: Provides caching mechanisms for LM calls and embedding computations, optimizing performance and reducing API costs.

nodes.label: OpenAI API Formatting
nodes.title: OpenAI Data Conversion
nodes.description: Handles conversion between DSPy's internal data structures and OpenAI's specific API request/response formats, including cost tracking.

nodes.label: LM Client Utilities
nodes.title: Client Utilities & Security
nodes.description: Offers utility functions for managing LiteLLM logging and secure disk serialization, enhancing observability and data integrity.

edges.label: Leverages for caching
edges.title: Leverages for caching
edges.description: LM clients utilize the caching module to store and retrieve responses, reducing redundant API calls.

edges.label: Calls if uncached
edges.title: Calls if uncached
edges.description: The caching module invokes LM clients to fetch responses when a requested item is not found in the cache.

edges.label: Uses for OpenAI API
edges.title: Uses for OpenAI API
edges.description: OpenAI-specific LM clients rely on the formatting module to prepare requests and parse responses according to OpenAI's API specifications.

edges.label: Provides formatted data to
edges.title: Provides formatted data to
edges.description: The OpenAI formatting module supplies structured requests to and processes responses from OpenAI-compatible LM clients.

edges.label: Utilizes for support
edges.title: Utilizes for support
edges.description: LM clients use the utility module for features like logging and secure data handling during their operations.

edges.label: Configures/Secures
edges.title: Configures/Secures
edges.description: The utility module provides configuration (e.g., logging) and security features (e.g., serialization) that support the LM clients.

groups.label: Core LM Interaction
groups.title: Core Language Model Interaction
groups.description: Manages the direct communication and integration with various Language Models, serving as the primary interface for LM operations.

groups.label: Data Processing & Optimization
groups.title: Data Processing & Optimization
groups.description: Handles efficient data exchange, caching, and API-specific formatting for LM interactions, ensuring performance and compatibility.

groups.label: System Utilities
groups.title: System Utilities & Security
groups.description: Provides foundational utilities for logging, debugging, and secure data handling within the LM integration layer, supporting robust operations.
